Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars" Special Program
The Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars" Special Program will release on 2026/10/30 19:30 (UTC+8).
In the maddening silence, a voice said: "Laugh, and let THEM hear your existence." And thus, the stars were silent no more, pouring all their radiance into a single burst of laughter.
Fun lovers of the universe, put on your masks of utmost elation!
Returning from miHoYo, The Laughter is about to make THEIR livestream debut! What kind of intel will THEY bring us?
Tune in to the official livestream on 2026/10/30 19:30 (UTC+8). Aha's Night is waiting for you to take the stage!
